description: A scrollbar you can read: a strip along the right edge of each thread, drawn like VS Code's minimap, with one rectangle per message, as tall as the message and coloured by kind (your messages, agent replies, work, errors, system notes). Drag its slider to scrub, click to glide there, scroll the wheel over it, or hover to see the rows around the pointer with an icon and the start of each one's text. It replaces BB's fading scrollbar, or keeps it beside the strip, casts a soft shade on a dark theme, and a settings panel in the thread menu sets the size, colours, slider, note and scrolling while you watch. It reads only what changed while a turn works and nothing while the strip is not shown. Requires BB 0.49 or later.
